q: Name an RFC by its number.
hint: Numbers only. Any RFC you can say something true about.

answers.l: HTTP/1.1, 1999. Replaced in 2014 and again in 2022, and still the one people cite.
Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol, April 1, 1998. The source of 418 I'm a teapot.
Defines MUST, SHOULD and MAY. Quoted at the top of thousands of specs.
IP over Avian Carriers, 1990. Tested in Bergen in 2001: 9 packets sent, 4 returned.
Transmission Control Protocol, 1981. Replaced by RFC 9293 in 2022.
User Datagram Protocol. Three pages long, from 1980.
Date and time on the internet. The sane subset of ISO 8601.
"Host Software," Steve Crocker, April 7, 1969. "Request for Comments" was chosen to sound tentative.
HTTP Semantics, 2022. Pulled together what every HTTP version shares.
UUIDs revisited, 2024. Adds the time-ordered v7.
JSON's first RFC, 2006, by Douglas Crockford.
The format of ARPA internet text messages, 1982. Email headers.
Internet Message Format, 2008. Email headers, revised.
UTF-8, limited to four bytes to match UTF-16.
CSV, 2005. Informational only. CSV never got a real standard.
TCP, rewritten in 2022 to replace RFC 793.
IPv6 as a full Internet Standard, 2017.
The Twelve Networking Truths. "With sufficient thrust, pigs fly just fine."
The Security Flag in the IPv4 Header, April 1, 2003. The "evil bit."
Clarifies that MUST and SHOULD only count when written in capitals.
iCalendar. The .ics files in your inbox.
ASCII format for network interchange, 1969, by Vint Cerf.
The Telnet RANDOMLY-LOSE option, April 1, 1978. The first April Fools RFC.
IP over Avian Carriers with Quality of Service, 1999.
The Infinite Monkey Protocol Suite, April 1, 2000.
Firewall Enhancement Protocol, April 1, 2001: tunnel everything over port 80.
TCP Option to Denote Packet Mood, April 1, 2010.
Software Defects Considered Harmful, April 1, 2022. "Authors MUST NOT implement bugs."
HTCPCP-TEA, 2014. Extended the coffee pot protocol to teapots.
The Internet is for End Users, 2020.

traps.q: Name the RFC, published April 1, 1998, that defined status code 418 I'm a teapot.
